download_transresnet_model: download the pretrained transresnet model for the personality captions task to a specified datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the transresnet.tgz model archive for personality captions
test_download_function: test the download function by calling it with a custom datapath directory
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it uses parlai core build_data download_models
summarize_transresnet_module: summarize the transresnet module which provides a single download function for the pretrained model
